title.ja: Big Hit、ミン・ヒジン元SM理事をCBOに迎え「新ガールズグループの立ち上げを主導」と発表
title.en: Big Hit hires former SM director Min Hee-jin as CBO, says she will lead a new girl group launch
title.original: 빅히트, 민희진 전 SM 이사 영입… '브랜드 총괄·걸그룹 론칭'

summary.ja: SM出身のミン・ヒジンをCBOに迎えたBig Hitが、彼女が新ガールズグループの立ち上げを主導し、自身のレーベルも設立すると発表した。
summary.en: Big Hit brought in former SM creative director Min Hee-jin as CBO, saying she would lead a new girl group launch and set up her own label.

editor_note: Seoul Shinmun (twig24) report published 2019-07-01 09:58 KST: '민희진 전 SM엔터테인먼트 크리에이티브 디렉터 겸 등기이사가 오늘부터 빅히트에 합류한다' / '새로운 걸그룹의 론칭을 주도할 계획'. Big Hit/HYBE newsroom (hybecorp.com) returns 403, so a same-day press report is used; verified=false. | note sentences already covered by detail: パン・シヒョク代表はミン・ヒジンを「K-POPに『ビジュアルディレクター』『企画者』という概念を定着させたリーダー中のリーダー」と評した。 ミン・ヒジンは少女時代、f(x)、SHINee、EXO、Red Velvetのコンセプトを手掛けてきた。 / Removed source mention from reader text: reported by Seoul Shinmun at 09:58 KST the same day.

detail.ja: Big Hit Entertainmentは、SMエンターテインメントの元クリエイティブディレクター兼登記理事ミン・ヒジンを同日付でブランド総括（CBO）として迎えると発表した。レーベル拡大と組織再編を進めるBig Hitと関係会社のブランディングを統括し、複数レーベルのクリエイティブディレクターを務めるほか、新ガールズグループのローンチを主導し、人材発掘と音楽制作のための自身のレーベルを設立する計画とされた。パン・シヒョク代表はミン・ヒジンをK-POPに「ビジュアルディレクター」と「企画者」という概念を定着させた「リーダー中のリーダー」と評し、ミン・ヒジンはクリエイターとしての第2章をBig Hitで始められる喜びと同時に負担も感じると述べた。2018年末にSMを退社した彼女は、少女時代、f(x)、SHINee、EXO、Red Velvetのコンセプトやブランディングで知られていた。
detail.en: Big Hit Entertainment announced that Min Hee-jin, former creative director and registered director of SM Entertainment, was joining that day as Chief Brand Officer. She was to oversee branding across Big Hit and its affiliates during the company's label expansion and restructuring, serve as creative director for several labels, lead the launch of a new girl group and establish her own label for talent scouting and music production. CEO Bang Si-hyuk called her a leader among leaders who established the roles of visual director and planner in K-pop, and Min said she was both happy and burdened to begin her second chapter as a creator at Big Hit. Having left SM at the end of 2018, she was known for concepts and branding for Girls' Generation, f(x), SHINee, EXO and Red Velvet.

title.ja: Big Hit会社説明会：PLUS GLOBAL AUDITION出身のSource Musicガールズグループを2021年デビューと発表
title.en: Big Hit corporate briefing: Source Music girl group from the Plus Global Audition to debut in 2021
title.original: 2020년 상반기 공동체와 함께하는 빅히트 회사 설명회

summary.ja: Big Hitが会社説明会で、PLUS GLOBAL AUDITIONで選ぶSource Musicのガールズグループを2021年にデビューさせると発表した。
summary.en: At a corporate briefing Big Hit said a Source Music girl group chosen through the Plus Global Audition would debut in 2021.

note: 発表したのはシン・ヨンジェBig Hitレーベル副代表。BTSとTOMORROW X TOGETHERを成功させた制作力とノウハウを集約したプロジェクトと説明した。
note_en: The announcement was made by Shin Young-jae, Big Hit's label vice president, who described it as a project drawing on the production capability and know-how behind BTS and TOMORROW X TOGETHER.
editor_note: Money Today (2020-02-05 16:48) says the briefing was held on 02-04 at DDP with contents released on 02-05 (press embargo); Kukinews dates it 02-05. Dated by the event (02-04). Min Hee-jin is not named in these reports. / Removed source mention from reader text: contents reported by Money Today on February 5, 2020.

detail.ja: ソウルの東大門デザインプラザ（DDP）で開かれた「2020年上半期 共同体と共にするBig Hit会社説明会」で、パン・シヒョク代表とキム・ドンジュン事業総括が登壇した。Big Hitは2022年までに新人3組をデビューさせる計画として、CJ ENMとの合弁BELIFT LABの多国籍ボーイズグループ（2020年、2019年3〜7月に国内外17都市のオーディションで選抜）、「PLUS GLOBAL AUDITION」で選ぶSource Musicのガールズグループ（2021年）、Big Hit直属のボーイズグループ（2022年）を挙げた。2019年の連結売上5,879億ウォン（前年比95%増）と営業利益875億ウォンも公表し、2020年の方向性を「ファン体験の革新」として、Play Zoneの拡大やツアービレッジ、BTS関連のドラマや韓国語学習コンテンツ、ゲームなどの計画を示した。ミン・ヒジンの名前は出なかった。
detail.en: Big Hit held its '2020 H1 corporate briefing with the community' at Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) in Seoul, with CEO Bang Si-hyuk and business head Kim Dong-jun presenting. It announced plans for three new groups by 2022: a multinational boy group from Belift Lab, its joint venture with CJ ENM, in 2020, selected through auditions in 17 cities in Korea and abroad from March to July 2019; a Source Music girl group in 2021, to be chosen through the 'Plus Global Audition'; and a Big Hit boy group in 2022. It also reported 2019 consolidated revenue of 587.9 billion won (up 95%) and operating profit of 87.5 billion won, set 'fan experience innovation' as its 2020 direction, and outlined plans including an expanded Play Zone, tour villages, a BTS-themed drama, Korean-learning content and a game. Min Hee-jin was not named at the briefing.

title.ja: Big Hit会社説明会：パン・シヒョク「ミン・ヒジンCBO・Source Musicと準備中のガールズグループは来年デビュー」
title.en: Big Hit corporate briefing: Bang Si-hyuk says the girl group prepared with Min Hee-jin and Source Music will debut next year

summary.ja: Big Hitのオンライン会社説明会で、パン・シヒョク議長がミン・ヒジンCBOと準備中のガールズグループの翌年デビューを明言した。
summary.en: At Big Hit's online corporate briefing, Bang Si-hyuk said the girl group being prepared with CBO Min Hee-jin would debut the next year.

note: 同じ説明会ではI-LAND（BELIFT LAB）出身グループのデビューメンバー選抜も予告された。
note_en: The same briefing also previewed the selection of debut members for the group from I-LAND (BELIFT LAB).
editor_note: Xports News 2020-08-13 13:56 KST: '민희진 빅히트 CBO, 쏘스뮤직과 함께 준비 중인 걸그룹도 내년 데뷔할 것'. The briefing video on the HYBE LABELS channel was not located (ID unknown).

detail.ja: オンラインで開かれ公式YouTubeチャンネルで配信された会社説明会。パン・シヒョク議長、ユン・ソクジュン グローバルCEO、イ・スンソクIP事業総括、キム・ドンジュン360事業総括、Weverseを運営するbeNXのソ・ウソク代表が登壇した。パン・シヒョク議長は、ミン・ヒジンCBOとSource Musicとともに準備中のガールズグループが翌年デビューすると述べ、BELIFT LABの「I-LAND」で結成するチームのデビューメンバーも間もなく決まるとした。BTSとTOMORROW X TOGETHERの年内カムバック、10月のオンライン・オフライン公演「BTS MAP OF THE SOUL ON:E」、2020年上半期の売上2,940億ウォンと営業利益497億ウォン、5月のPledis合流によるレーベル4社体制、Weverseの1周年も報告された。
detail.en: Big Hit held its '2020 H2 corporate briefing with the community' online, streamed on its official YouTube channel, with chairman Bang Si-hyuk, global CEO Yoon Seok-joon, IP business head Lee Seung-seok, Big Hit 360 head Kim Dong-jun and beNX (Weverse) CEO Seo Woo-seok presenting. Bang said the girl group being prepared with CBO Min Hee-jin and Source Music would debut the following year, and that the debut lineup of the team formed through Belift Lab's 'I-LAND' would be decided soon. The briefing also covered comebacks by BTS and Tomorrow X Together later in the year, the October online and offline concert 'BTS MAP OF THE SOUL ON:E', first-half 2020 revenue of 294.0 billion won and operating profit of 49.7 billion won, the move to four labels after Pledis joined in May, and Weverse's first anniversary.

title.ja: HYBE、新レーベルADOR設立を発表（ミン・ヒジンCBOが代表に就任、ガールズグループは2022年デビュー）
title.en: HYBE announces new label ADOR with CBO Min Hee-jin as CEO; girl group to debut in 2022
title.original: 하이브, 신규 레이블 어도어(ADOR) 설립…민희진 CBO 대표 선임

summary.ja: HYBEが独立レーベルADORを設立し、ミン・ヒジンCBOが代表に就任。新人ガールズグループは2022年デビューとした。
summary.en: HYBE set up the independent label ADOR with CBO Min Hee-jin as CEO, and slated its new girl group for a 2022 debut.

note: 合弁や買収ではなくHYBEが自ら設立した初の独自レーベル。ミン・ヒジンは「新レーベル設立を通じて音楽産業に再び変化をもたらす準備を終えた」とコメントした。
note_en: HYBE's first label founded by HYBE itself rather than through a joint venture or acquisition. Min Hee-jin commented that she had 'finished preparing to bring change to the music industry again by founding a new label'.
editor_note: Replaces the month-precision record notice-2021-11-01-ador-established. Announcement date 2021-11-12 is consistent across Soompi, Kstyle (Newsen report distributed 09:23 KST), Korea JoongAng Daily (10:41) and NME. The corporate entity was created by a physical spin-off of the Source Music label business with a spin-off date of 2021-11-02 and 16.1bn won capital (Hankyung Business 2024; one report says 15.4bn). HYBE newsroom returns 403 and no official page was fetched, so verified=false. | note sentences already covered by detail: ADORは「All Doors One Room」の略。 / Removed source mentions from reader text: Newsen (09:23 KST), Korea JoongAng Daily (10:41), Soompi and NME reported the same day.

detail.ja: HYBEはマルチレーベル体制の下に独立レーベルADOR（All Doors One Room）を設立し、ミン・ヒジンCBOが代表に就任すると発表した。ADORは独自の哲学とスタイルで運営され、親会社が試みていない事業にも取り組むとされ、2019年のPLUS GLOBAL AUDITION出身者を中心とする新人ガールズグループを2022年にデビューさせ、ミン・ヒジンが制作全般を総括する。ミン・ヒジンは新レーベルを通じて音楽業界に再び変化を起こす準備が整ったと述べ、ADORの哲学を反映した新しいアーティストIPとコンテンツを示していくと表明した。
detail.en: HYBE announced the independent label ADOR (All Doors One Room) under its multi-label system, with CBO Min Hee-jin as CEO. ADOR was to operate with its own philosophy and style and pursue ventures the parent company had not attempted, and would debut a new girl group in 2022 drawn mainly from the 2019 Plus Global Audition, with Min overseeing all production. Min said she was fully prepared to bring about another change in the music industry through the label and pledged new artist IP and content reflecting ADOR's philosophy.

title.ja: デビュー100日：公式ファンダム名「Bunnies」を発表
title.en: Debut 100th day: official fandom name 'Bunnies' revealed

summary.ja: デビュー100日記念のクイズショー動画で、公式ファンクラブ名「Bunnies」と愛称「トッキ」が初めて明かされた。
summary.en: A 100th-day quiz show video revealed the official fan club name 'Bunnies' and the nickname 'Tokki'.

editor_note: Video exists on the official channel (ID from local channel crawl). Upload date 2022-10-29 per MBC report ('데뷔 100일') and TVDB; not fetched from YouTube directly, so verified=false. / Video ID from local channel crawl; upload date 2022-10-29 per MBC report ('데뷔 100일') and TVDB, not fetched from YouTube directly (verified=false). Cut for length: quiz topics included proverbs, pager codes and 'Friendship Day'; Bunnies was explained as a friend-like presence to the rabbits (NewJeans) and the Binky Bong as reflecting the warm feelings between the two.

detail.ja: デビュー100日目に、公式YouTubeチャンネルの「デビュー100日記念 Special Quiz Show」と公式SNSで、公式ファンクラブ名「Bunnies（バニーズ）」と公式ペンライト「ビンキボン」を発表した。動画ではウサギの帽子をかぶった5人が「人間ウサギ」として友情をテーマにしたクイズに挑み、最後の連想クイズで「一緒に」「Phoning」「親友」「ファンクラブ」のキーワードからBunniesと愛称「トッキ」が明かされた。メンバーはPhoningに韓国語と英語で感謝のメッセージを投稿し、自分たちを通してファンが幸せになってほしいと伝えた。
detail.en: On their 100th day since debut, NewJeans revealed the official fan club name 'Bunnies' and the official light stick 'Binky Bong' through the 'Debut 100th day Special Quiz Show' on their official YouTube channel and through official social media. In the video the five members, wearing rabbit hats as 'human rabbits', took on friendship-themed quizzes, and in the final word-association round the keywords 'together', 'Phoning', 'best friend' and 'fan club' led to the reveal of Bunnies and the nickname 'Tokki'. The members posted thank-you messages in Korean and English on Phoning, saying they hoped fans would find happiness through them.

title.ja: 初カムバック：シングル『OMG』を2023年1月2日発売と発表
title.en: First comeback: single album 'OMG' announced for January 2, 2023

summary.ja: デビュー作が夏なら今作は冬、と位置づけた初のシングルアルバム『OMG』の発売日が2023年1月2日と発表された。
summary.en: ADOR set January 2, 2023 for the first single album OMG, framed as the group's winter after the debut's summer.

note: 収録曲はタイトル曲と、ファン（Bunnies）と迎える初めての冬のために用意した特別な冬の曲で構成されると説明された。
note_en: ADOR said the album would consist of a title track and a special winter track prepared for the group's first winter with their fans, Bunnies.
editor_note: Task brief mentioned a 'NewJeans of Winter' announcement on 2022-12-02; sources show the comeback date notice on 2022-11-10 and the first teasers on 2022-12-12 (the latter already in tweet.json). Reader note replaced: the old note named 'Ditto' and the 'NewJeans of Winter' teaser, which were not public on Nov 10. en.wikipedia attributes the news to HYBE's community briefing (Park Ji-won) the same day.

detail.ja: ADORは、初のシングルアルバム『OMG』を2023年1月2日に発売し、12月19日に収録曲を先行公開すると発表した。デビューアルバム『New Jeans』の制作過程で書かれた曲と冬の情緒を持つ曲が収録されるとし、ミン・ヒジン代表は「デビューアルバムがNewJeansの夏を見せたとすれば、今回のシングルアルバムはNewJeansの冬を見せるアルバムになる」と述べた。
detail.en: ADOR announced that NewJeans' first single album OMG would be released on January 2, 2023, with a track pre-released on December 19. The album was to include songs written during production of the debut album New Jeans and songs with a winter feel, and CEO Min Hee-jin said that if the debut album showed NewJeans' summer, this single album would show their winter.

detail.en: Packshots released by ADOR for the 2nd EP Get Up showed that it would come in three formats: Bunny Beach Bag ver., THE POWERPUFF GIRLS X NJ Box ver. and Weverse Albums ver. The Bunny Beach Bag ver. is a square beach-bag package in pink, white or blue holding a photobook, lyrics, photocards, stickers, postcards, a bookmark and the CD, and can be decorated with key rings and badges and carried. The THE POWERPUFF GIRLS X NJ Box ver. comes from the collaboration with Cartoon Network's The Powerpuff Girls. The EP had been on pre-order since June 19, with pre-release songs due on July 7 and the EP on July 21.

detail.ja: HYBEはADORのミン・ヒジン代表と役員A氏らに対する監査に着手した。監査チームは同日午前にADOR経営陣の業務区域を訪れ、会社のIT資産の回収と対面での陳述確保を進めた。HYBEはADOR取締役会に臨時株主総会の招集を要請し、ミン代表に辞任を求める書簡を送った。ADOR経営陣が投資家誘致のため社外秘の契約書などを流出させた疑い、HYBEにADOR株を売却させる方法を協議した疑いを挙げ、回収資産の内容次第で必要なら法的措置を取るとした。HYBEはADOR株の80%を保有し、ミン代表は前年に18%（573,160株）を取得した第2位株主だった。
detail.en: HYBE began an audit of ADOR CEO Min Hee-jin and an executive identified as A, among others. Its audit staff visited ADOR's management offices that morning to retrieve company IT assets and secure in-person statements, and HYBE asked ADOR's board to convene an extraordinary shareholders' meeting and sent Min a letter demanding her resignation. HYBE alleged that ADOR's management had leaked confidential documents such as contracts to attract investors and had discussed ways to make HYBE sell its ADOR shares, and said it would take legal action if necessary depending on the retrieved assets. detail.ja: HYBEの監査着手を受け、ADORは同日夜に公式立場を出した。HYBEとBELIFT LABに対し、前月デビューしたBELIFT LABの新人ILLITによるNewJeansのコピー問題を含め、HYBEがNewJeansに対して取ってきた一連の行為について公式に問題を提起し、それに先立ってNewJeansのブランド価値毀損に関するHYBEの立場を求める書簡も送っていたと説明した。HYBEとBELIFT LABは具体的な回答を先延ばしにした末、同日ミン・ヒジン代表の職務停止と解任手続きの開始を通告してきたとし、経営権奪取を図ったとする報道は根拠がなく、NewJeansの文化的成果を守るための抗議がADORの利益を害するはずがないと反論した。
detail.en: ADOR issued an official statement that evening in response to HYBE's audit. It said it had formally raised concerns with HYBE and BELIFT LAB about a series of HYBE's actions toward NewJeans, including the copying issue involving BELIFT LAB's rookie group ILLIT, which had debuted the previous month, and had earlier sent HYBE a letter asking for its position on the damage to NewJeans' brand value. It said HYBE and BELIFT LAB delayed a concrete response and then notified ADOR that day that they would suspend CEO Min Hee-jin's duties and begin dismissal proceedings, called reports that she tried to seize management control baseless, and argued that protesting on behalf of NewJeans' cultural achievements could not harm ADOR's interests.

detail.ja: ミン・ヒジン代表が法律代理人（法務法人セジョン）とともにソウル・瑞草区の韓国カンファレンスセンターで開いた約2時間の会見で、KBS、SBS、MBCや複数のYouTubeチャンネルが生中継した。ミン代表は経営権奪取を計画・意図・実行したことはないと述べ、副代表とのカカオトークのやり取りは業務上の愚痴だったと説明し、代理人はHYBEが80%、ミン側が20%を持つ構造で奪取は不可能だと主張した。HYBEがNewJeansを最初のガールズグループとしてデビューさせる約束を破りLE SSERAFIMを先に出したことを対立の発端に挙げ、パン・シヒョク議長やパク・ジウォン代表とのメッセージの一部を公開して、HYBEの主張は自分を追い出すために仕組まれたものだとし、「私がHYBEを裏切ったのではなく、HYBEが私を裏切った」と語った。HYBEは同日午前、中間監査結果として経営権奪取計画の具体的な事実と物証を確保したと発表していた。
detail.en: ADOR CEO Min Hee-jin held an emergency press conference of about two hours with her lawyers from the law firm Sejong at the Korea Conference Center in Seocho-gu, Seoul, livestreamed by KBS, SBS, MBC and several YouTube channels. She said she had never planned, intended or carried out a takeover of management control, described her KakaoTalk exchange with the vice president as workplace venting, and her lawyer argued a takeover was impossible with HYBE holding 80% and her side 20%. She traced the conflict to HYBE breaking an agreement to debut NewJeans as its first girl group by debuting LE SSERAFIM first, released parts of her messages with chairman Bang Si-hyuk and CEO Park Ji-won, called HYBE's allegations a frame-up to push her out, and said it was HYBE that had betrayed her, not the other way round. That morning HYBE had announced interim audit results claiming specific facts and physical evidence of a takeover plan.

detail.ja: ソウル中央地裁民事合議50部（キム・サンフン首席部長判事）は、ミン・ヒジン代表が申請した議決権行使禁止の仮処分を認め、翌31日のADOR臨時株主総会でHYBEがミン代表の解任案に賛成の議決権を行使することを禁じ、違反した場合は200億ウォンを支払うよう命じた。裁判所は、解任・辞任事由の疎明責任を負うHYBEの疎明が十分でなく、その存否は本案で判断すべきで、総会が差し迫っている以上、取締役の地位を失えば後の金銭賠償では回復できないとした。一方、ミン代表がNewJeansをHYBEから切り離す方法やHYBEにADOR株を売らせる方法を模索したことは明らかだが具体的な実行には至っておらず、「背信的行為」ではあってもADORに対する背任には当たらないと判断した。
detail.en: The Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 50 (presiding senior judge Kim Sang-hoon) granted Min Hee-jin's injunction, barring HYBE from voting in favor of her dismissal at ADOR's extraordinary shareholders' meeting the next day, with a penalty of 20 billion won for any violation. The court held that HYBE bore the burden of showing grounds for dismissal or resignation and had not sufficiently done so, that the question belonged to the main suit, and that with the meeting imminent, the loss of her directorship could not be remedied by later compensation. It also found that Min had clearly explored ways to take NewJeans out of HYBE's sphere or to pressure HYBE into selling its ADOR shares, but that this had not reached concrete action and, while a betrayal, did not amount to a breach of duty against ADOR.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 50 (presiding judge Kim Sang-hoon)

title.ja: ADOR臨時株主総会、ミン・ヒジン代表は留任・2回目の記者会見

HYBE said it respected the court decision and would take further steps within the law. / 2026-10-24 nightly: ADOR・HYBEの公式発表ページはなく、SPOTV NEWS（Daum配信、2024-05-31 16:33）を取得してミン代表の留任、シン副代表・キム理事の解任、キム・ジュヨン（CHRO）・イ・ジェサン（CSO）・イ・ギョンジュン（CFO）の選任、光化門プレスセンターでの2回目の会見内容、HYBEのコメントを確認。

detail.ja: 前日の仮処分決定により、HYBEはミン・ヒジン代表個人の解任案に議決権を行使できず、ミン代表は留任した。一方、ミン側とされるシン副代表とキム理事は解任され、HYBEが推薦したキム・ジュヨン（HYBE CHRO）、イ・ジェサン（CSO）、イ・ギョンジュン（CFO）が社内取締役に選ばれた。ミン代表は同日、光化門のプレスセンターで2回目の会見を開いて「身軽になった」と話し、大義のために次の章へ進もうとHYBEに和解を提案し、自分も一歩引くと述べた。裁判所がメディアで流れた主張の一部を正しくないと判断したとして決定の尊重を求め、東京ドーム公演、2025年のワールドツアー、年末のアルバムに影響が出ていると説明して、双方をゼロに戻しNewJeansの計画を維持しようと提案した。HYBEは法の枠内で後続の手続きを進めるとコメントした。
detail.en: Because of the previous day's injunction, HYBE could not vote to dismiss CEO Min Hee-jin personally at ADOR's extraordinary shareholders' meeting in Seoul, and she remained CEO. Vice President Shin and Director Kim, regarded as her allies, were removed, and HYBE's nominees Kim Ju-young (HYBE CHRO), Lee Jae-sang (CSO) and Lee Kyung-jun (CFO) were appointed inside directors. The same day Min held a second press conference at the Press Center in Gwanghwamun, said she felt unburdened, proposed reconciliation with HYBE so that everyone could move to the next chapter for the greater good, and said she too would give up a step. She asked HYBE to respect the ruling, saying the court had found some media claims against her incorrect, said the Tokyo Dome show, a 2025 world tour and a year-end album had been affected, and proposed treating both sides as zero while keeping the NewJeans plan intact. HYBE said it would pursue follow-up procedures within the bounds of the law.

detail.ja: ADORの取締役会が、社内取締役でHYBEの最高人事責任者（CHRO）のキム・ジュヨンを新代表に選んだ。HYBEは8月24日に「代表理事変更の件」を議題とする27日の取締役会を通知しており、ミン・ヒジンはビデオ通話で参加した。ADORは、ミン・ヒジンは代表を退くが社内取締役として残りNewJeansのプロデュースを続けるとし、経営とプロデュースの分離がADORの利益になると説明した。ミン側は、本人の同意なく一方的に決議された解任で株主間契約の重大な違反だとし、プロデュース業務の継続は協議されておらず一方的な通告で、続けるかどうかはまだ決めていないと述べた。

HYBE had given notice on August 24 of a board meeting on the 27th with a 'change of CEO' on the agenda, and Min Hee-jin joined by video call. detail.ja: メンバーが9月11日の生配信で示した期限の日に、ADORはミン・ヒジンの代表復帰要求への回答を発表した。取締役会はミン・ヒジンを社内取締役に再選任するための臨時株主総会の招集を決議する一方、代表への復帰は「現時点では受け入れられない」とした。ADORは9月11日、専属契約の残存期間全体にあたる5年間のプロデュース業務をミン・ヒジンに提案し、プロデューサーとしての地位、任期、権限の基本的な保証を示して詳細は今後協議するとしていた。取締役会の議論とメンバーの質問への回答は、メンバーにメールで詳しく送られた。ミン側は9月13日、臨時株主総会の招集と社内取締役再選任を求める仮処分をソウル中央地裁に申請していた。
detail.en: On September 25, the deadline set in the members' September 11 livestream, ADOR announced its reply to the demand for Min Hee-jin's return as CEO. Its board resolved to convene an extraordinary shareholders' meeting to re-elect Min as an inside director, but said her return as CEO was not acceptable at present. ADOR noted that on September 11 it had offered Min a five-year producing role for NewJeans covering the full remaining term of the group's contract, with basic guarantees on her position, term and authority as producer and further conditions to be negotiated. The board's discussion and answers to the members' questions were sent to the members in detail by email. Min's side had on September 13 asked the Seoul Central District Court for an injunction seeking an EGM and her re-election as inside director.

title.ja: ハニ、国会環境労働委員会の国政監査に参考人として出席
title.en: Hanni testifies as a witness at the National Assembly labor committee audit

summary.ja: ハニが国会の国政監査に参考人として出席し、職場内いじめの経験を涙ながらに証言した。
summary.en: Hanni testified in tears as a reference witness at a National Assembly audit on workplace harassment.

editor_note: Afternoon session; exact start time not given in reports (arrival ~13:58, testimony reported 15:48). / 2026-10-24 nightly: 国会の公式映像ページは未取得。ニューシス（2024-10-15 15:53）でハニの発言（法がすべてを解決できなくても人間として尊重すれば…、先輩・同期・後輩・練習生、メンバーと職員は謝らなくてよい、謝るべき人は分かっていない、オーストラリア大使館が両親に連絡）、キム・ジュヨン代表の発言、BELIFT LABの反論を確認。京郷新聞でも参考人出席を確認。

detail.ja: ハニが汝矣島の国会で環境労働委員会の国政監査に参考人として出席し、職場内のいじめと嫌がらせをめぐる質疑で証言した。ハニは前月の生配信で、HYBE傘下の別レーベル（ILLITのBELIFT LAB）のマネージャーが聞こえるように「無視して」と言ったと主張し、BELIFT LABはCCTV映像と内部調査を根拠に否定していた。ハニは涙ながらに、法律がすべてを解決できなくても人を人として尊重すれば職場のいじめや仲間外れはなくなると述べ、問題を提起してくれた人々に感謝し、先輩や同僚、後輩、練習生が同じ心配をしなくて済むよう願った。家族のような韓国人メンバーやスタッフが代わりに謝る必要はなく、謝るべき人がそれを分かっていないとも語り、両親に連絡してくれたオーストラリア大使館に感謝した。ADORのキム・ジュヨン代表も出席し、双方の主張が食い違っており事実関係を確認中だと述べた。
detail.en: Hanni appeared as a reference witness at the National Assembly Environment and Labor Committee's state audit in Yeouido, testifying in a session on workplace harassment and bullying. In the previous month's livestream she had said a manager from another HYBE label (ILLIT's BELIFT LAB) had said 'ignore her' within her hearing, which BELIFT LAB disputed citing CCTV footage and an internal review. In tears she said that even if laws cannot solve everything, workplace harassment and ostracism would not exist if people were treated as human, thanked those who raised the issue, and hoped seniors, peers, juniors and trainees would not have to worry about this. She said her Korean members and staff, who are like family, need not apologize on her behalf while those who should apologize did not understand this, and thanked the Australian embassy for contacting her parents. ADOR CEO Kim Ju-young also attended and said the accounts conflicted and the facts were still being verified.

credits.body: National Assembly Environment and Labor Committee (state audit)

title.ja: メンバー、ADORに内容証明を送付（14日以内の是正要求）
title.en: Members send certified letter to ADOR demanding remedies within 14 days

summary.ja: メンバー5人がADORに内容証明を送り、ミン・ヒジンの復帰などを求めて、14日以内に是正されなければ契約を解除すると通告した。
summary.en: The five members sent ADOR a certified letter demanding remedies, including Min Hee-jin's return, within 14 days or they would terminate.

note: ADORの回答期限は、内容証明の受領から14日以内とされた。
note_en: ADOR was given 14 days from receipt of the letter to respond.
editor_note: Letter reported by Yonhap on 11-13; ADOR's receipt statement 11-14. / Removed source mentions from reader text: reported by Yonhap; ADOR's comment was given to Ilgan Sports. / 2026-10-24 nightly: Ilgan Sports/Edaily (2024-11-13 18:13 KST) confirms the letter, the 14-day deadline, each listed demand, the termination warning, the family-rumour line and ADOR's 'not yet received' comment; no official members' page exists. Reader note replaced: the old note described ADOR's 11-14 comment (after the record date); kept here instead: ADOR said on the 14th it had received the letter and was reviewing it.

detail.ja: メンバー5人（ミンジ、ハニ、ダニエル・マーシュ、ヘリン、ヘイン）が本名と署名入りの内容証明をADORに送り、受領から14日以内に列挙した専属契約の重大な違反をすべて是正するよう求めた。要求は、NewJeansを切り捨てる決定をした人物と不正行為者を特定し背任などの民事・刑事措置を取ること、監査報告書と人事措置の報告書の提出、ハニに「無視して」と言ったマネージャーの正式な謝罪、無断で使われた映像・写真の削除、「アルバム押し込み」による損害の評価と対策、シン・ウソク監督との紛争と既存作品の損失の解決、NewJeansの固有性と創作物の保護、ミン・ヒジン前代表のADOR経営とNewJeansプロデュースへの復帰。受け入れられなければ専属契約を解除するとし、家族をめぐる根拠のない噂にも厳しく対応するとした。ADORは、内容証明をまだ受け取っておらず回答できないとコメントした。
detail.en: The five members (Minji, Hanni, Danielle Marsh, Haerin and Hyein) sent ADOR a certified letter under their legal names with their signatures, demanding that all listed material breaches of the exclusive contract be corrected within 14 days of receipt. The demands were to identify who decided to drop NewJeans and who committed misconduct and take civil and criminal action such as for breach of trust; to provide an audit report and a report on personnel actions; a formal apology from the manager who told Hanni to 'ignore' her; deletion of videos and photos used without consent; assessment of and remedies for damage from forced album sales ('push-out'); resolution of the dispute with director Shin Woo-seok and the resulting loss of existing work; protection of NewJeans' distinctive identity and creative output; and the return of former CEO Min Hee-jin to lead ADOR's management and NewJeans' production. The members said they would terminate the contract if ADOR did not accept and would respond firmly to unfounded rumors about their families. ADOR said it had not yet received the letter and could not comment.

title.ja: 雇用労働部、ハニの職場内いじめ申告を「労働者に当たらない」として行政終結
title.en: Labor ministry closes Hanni's workplace-harassment complaint: not a 'worker' under labor law

summary.ja: 雇用労働部の支庁が、ハニは勤労基準法上の労働者に当たらないとして職場内いじめの申告を行政終結した。
summary.en: A labor ministry office closed the harassment complaint over Hanni, ruling she is not a 'worker' under the Labor Standards Act.

editor_note: Government decision, not an ADOR notice; included because it closes the harassment complaint thread raised in the 09-11 live and the 10-15 testimony. No ADOR statement found. / Government decision, not an ADOR notice; included because it closes the harassment-complaint thread from the 09-11 live and the 10-15 testimony. No ADOR statement found. The source (Ilgan Sports) also notes the long-standing administrative view and a 2019 Supreme Court precedent treating entertainers' exclusive contracts as non-employment, and lawmakers' calls at the October state audit for protective legislation; omitted from reader text as background. / 2026-10-24 nightly: Ilgan Sports (2024-11-20 09:38 KST) confirms the Seoul Western branch office's administrative closure, the ~100 fan complaints and each ground listed in the detail.

detail.ja: 雇用労働部ソウル地方雇用労働庁ソウル西部支庁が、ハニの職場内いじめに関する申告を行政終結した。申告は、ハニが9月11日の生配信で他のアーティストに挨拶した際マネージャーから「無視して」と言われたと話したことを受け、ファン約100人が出したもの。支庁は、ハニとADORは対等な契約当事者で会社の指揮・監督下になく、正社員向けの就業規則や制度が適用されず、勤務時間や勤務場所の定めがなく、活動費用を双方で分担し、報酬は労働の対価ではなく収益配分で、税金も勤労所得ではなく事業所得として納めていることを挙げ、ハニは勤労基準法上の労働者とは言い難く、同法の職場内いじめ規定は適用されないと判断した。
detail.en: The Seoul Western branch of the Seoul Regional Employment and Labor Office of the Ministry of Employment and Labor administratively closed the workplace-harassment complaint concerning Hanni. About 100 fans had filed it after Hanni said in the September 11 livestream that a manager had told her to 'ignore' another artist she greeted. The office found that Hanni and ADOR were equal contracting parties not under the company's direction and supervision, that work rules and systems for regular employees did not apply to her, that she had no fixed hours or workplace, that the costs of her activities were shared, that her pay was profit-sharing rather than wages, and that she paid business-income rather than wage-income tax; she therefore could not be regarded as a worker under the Labor Standards Act, and its workplace-harassment provisions did not apply.

credits.issuer: Ministry of Employment and Labor, Seoul Western branch office

title.ja: ミン・ヒジン、ADOR社内取締役を辞任
title.en: Min Hee-jin resigns as ADOR inside director

summary.ja: ミン・ヒジンがADOR社内取締役を辞任し、HYBEとの株主間契約も解除すると発表した。
summary.en: Min Hee-jin resigned from ADOR's board and said she was terminating her shareholders' agreement with HYBE.

detail.ja: ミン・ヒジンが「本日ADOR社内取締役を辞任する」と発表し、HYBEと結んだ株主間契約も解除するとした。4月のHYBEの内部監査以降ADORを元の状態に戻そうと努めたがHYBEは過ちを認めず変化の兆しもないこと、HYBEが「経営権奪取」という虚偽の枠組みで不当な攻撃を続けたこと、HYBEが示したプロデュース業務契約にフォレンジックへの同意やR&R文書を示さない対面限定の秘密保持契約などの「毒素条項」があったことを理由に挙げ、株主間契約違反の責任を追及し、違法行為には法的措置を取ると述べた。ADORは一方的な辞任の通告は残念だとし、NewJeansの支援に最善を尽くすとした。ミン・ヒジンは11月初めに保有ADOR株のプットオプション行使をHYBEに通知しており、HYBEは株主間契約はすでに解除されたと主張していた。
detail.en: Min Hee-jin announced that she was resigning as an inside director of ADOR that day and terminating her shareholders' agreement with HYBE. She said that since HYBE's internal audit in April she had tried to restore ADOR to its pre-April state but HYBE had not admitted fault or shown any sign of change, that HYBE had fabricated a 'management takeover' frame and kept up unreasonable attacks, and that HYBE's proposed producing-services agreement contained 'toxic clauses' such as consent to forensics and an in-person-only NDA with the R&R documents withheld; she said she would hold HYBE liable for breaching the agreement and take legal action over its illegal acts. ADOR called the unilateral notice regrettable and said it would do its best to support NewJeans. Min had notified HYBE in early November that she was exercising a put option on her ADOR stake, while HYBE maintained the shareholders' agreement had already been terminated.

editor_note: Newsis report at 14:24 KST. The report estimates the put option at about 26 billion won (an estimate, kept out of reader text). Cut for length: Min's reasons also included sending two internal whistleblower emails in April, and she specified the 'toxic clauses' as consent to forensics and an in-person-only NDA, with the R&R documents withheld. / 2026-10-24 nightly: Newsis (2024-11-20, 종합2보) confirms the resignation, termination of the shareholders' agreement, the stated reasons, the 'toxic clauses', planned legal action, HYBE's position and the early-November put-option notice. ADOR's 'regrettable' comment is from the other references.

title.ja: ADOR、「無視して」発言についてハニの証言を「全面的に信頼」と公式SNSで表明
title.en: ADOR says on official SNS it 'fully trusts' Hanni's account of the 'ignore her' remark

summary.ja: ADORが公式SNSで、BELIFT LAB関係者の「無視して」発言についてハニの証言を全面的に信頼すると表明した。
summary.en: ADOR said on its official social media that it fully trusts Hanni's account of being told 'ignore her' by a BELIFT LAB staffer.

note: 内容証明の回答期限は翌28日。
note_en: The deadline for a reply to the certified letter was the next day, the 28th.
editor_note: Posted on NewJeans official X (@NewJeans_ADOR) per reports; the status URL could not be retrieved, so an OSEN full-text report is used. BELIFT LAB had denied the remark on 2024-10-07. / Removed source mention from reader text: OSEN, 16:01 KST; BELIFT LAB's Korean post title translated. / 2026-10-24 nightly: OSEN (2024-11-27 16:01 KST) and Korea Times confirm the statement and its content but say only 'official SNS'; neither names the NewJeans X account, and no status URL was found, so the X attribution was removed from summary, detail and credits.

detail.ja: ADORが公式SNSで、ハニの「無視して」発言をめぐる立場を出した。事実関係の争いから不要な論争を避けるため慎重な態度をとってきたが論争が収まらないとし、内容証明の要求を履行する措置の一環だと説明した。ハニは2024年5月27日にBELIFT LABの関係者から「無視して」または「無視して通り過ぎて」と言われたことを明確に記憶しており、BELIFT LABの主張はハニの証言とまったく異なるとし、被害者に短い出来事の細部まで記憶するよう求めるのは過酷で厳しすぎる基準だとした。ADORとスタッフはアーティストの言葉を全面的に信頼しハニの被害に共感するとして、BELIFT LABに被害を真摯に受け止め、互いを尊重し誠意ある態度を示すよう求めた。BELIFT LABは10月7日にXで「お知らせ」として自らの立場を出していた。
detail.en: ADOR posted a statement on Hanni's 'ignore her' remark on its official social media. It said it had kept a cautious stance to avoid unnecessary controversy over a factual dispute, but the controversy had not subsided, and that the statement was part of fulfilling the demands in the certified letter. ADOR said Hanni clearly remembers being told 'ignore her' or 'ignore her and walk past' by a BELIFT LAB staff member on May 27, 2024, that BELIFT LAB's claims differed entirely from her account, and that requiring a victim to recall every detail of a brief incident was too harsh and strict a standard. ADOR and its staff said they fully trusted their artist's words and sympathized with the harm she suffered, and asked BELIFT LAB to take the harm seriously, show mutual respect and adopt a sincere attitude. BELIFT LAB had posted its own position on X on October 7 under the title 'Notice'.

title.ja: メンバー5人、専属契約解除を通告する緊急記者会見
title.en: Members hold emergency press conference announcing contract termination

summary.ja: メンバー5人が緊急記者会見を開き、ADORとの専属契約を11月29日0時付で解除すると発表した。
summary.en: At an emergency press conference the five members announced they were terminating their ADOR contracts as of midnight on November 29.

note: ADORは同夜、内容証明への回答前に会見が行われたことに遺憾を表し、専属契約は依然有効だと反論した。
note_en: That night ADOR expressed regret that the press conference was held before it had replied to the letter, and countered that the exclusive contracts remained valid.
editor_note: 20:30 KST start confirmed by multiple reports. Members said they had no plan to seek a court injunction themselves. / 20:30 KST start confirmed by multiple reports (fnnews primary). Members said they had no plan to seek a court injunction themselves. Reports cited industry estimates of a penalty of 400 to 600 billion won (an estimate, kept out of reader text). Cut for length: the November 13 letter's demands were the return of former CEO Min Hee-jin, an apology from the manager who told Hanni to 'ignore' her, deletion of photos and videos used without consent, remedies for damage from forced album sales, resolution of the dispute with director Shin Woo-seok, and guarantees of NewJeans' identity and creative work. / 2026-10-24 nightly: Financial News (2024-11-29 04:30 and 11:26 KST) confirms the 20:30 press conference in Gangnam (photo caption: Space Share Samseong Station Center), termination from 0:00 on Nov 29, and the Hyein/Haerin/Minji remarks on the name, penalty and injunction. Minji's wish to keep working with Min Hee-jin is from the other references.

detail.ja: メンバー5人がソウル江南区のスペースシェア三成駅センターで緊急記者会見を開き、ADORとの専属契約を11月29日0時付で解除すると発表した。11月13日の内容証明にADORが28日までに応じなかったとし、ADORにはNewJeansを守る意志も能力もなく、残っても時間の無駄で精神的な苦痛が続くと説明した。ヘインは当分NewJeansの名前を使えなくても名前の権利を取り戻すため努力すると述べ、ヘリンは契約に違反したのはADORとHYBEで違約金を払う理由はないとし、ミンジは契約は終わったので仮処分や訴訟は必要なく、できればミン・ヒジンと仕事を続けたいと語った。
detail.en: The five members held an emergency press conference at Space Share Samseong Station Center in Gangnam-gu, Seoul, announcing that their exclusive contracts with ADOR would terminate as of midnight on November 29. They said ADOR had not responded to their November 13 certified letter by the 28th, that ADOR had neither the will nor the ability to protect NewJeans, and that staying would waste their time and prolong their distress. Hyein said they might not be able to use the NewJeans name for a time but would work to regain the rights to it; Haerin said ADOR and HYBE had breached the contract and no penalty was owed; Minji said that because the contract had ended no injunction or lawsuit was needed, and that she would like to keep working with Min Hee-jin if possible.

credits.venue: Space Share Samseong Station Center, Gangnam-gu, Seoul

title.ja: メンバー側「解除通知が到達し契約は終了、仮処分申請は不要」
title.en: Members' statement: termination notice delivered, no need for an injunction

summary.ja: メンバー側は解除通知の到達で契約は終了したと主張し、ADORは専属契約はなお有効だと回答した。
summary.en: The members said their termination notice had ended the contract; ADOR replied that the contract remained valid.

note: ADORは「一方的に信頼が壊れたと主張しても解除事由にはならない」との立場を重ねて示した。
note_en: ADOR repeated its position that 'unilaterally claiming trust has broken down is not grounds for termination'.

detail.ja: メンバー側は公式立場文で、専属契約の解除通知がADORに届いて即時に効力が生じたため契約はこの日で終わっており、仮処分を申請する理由はなく自由に活動できると主張した。ADORは同日のメールでの回答で専属契約はなお有効だとし、アーティストの望む方法や主観的な期待に沿わないことは契約違反に当たらず、要求の多くは第三者の行為に関するもので第三者に謝罪や合意を強いることはできず、明確な根拠なく第三者への法的措置を求めることは専属契約の目的に照らして適切でないとして、スケジュール、報酬、精算など契約上の主要事項は適切に履行してきたと述べた。内容証明から2週間、メンバーと直接会えなかったことを残念とし、対話を望むとした。
detail.en: The members' side issued a statement saying their termination notice had reached ADOR and taken immediate effect, so the contract had ended that day, there was no reason to seek an injunction, and they could work freely. ADOR replied the same day by email that the exclusive contract remained valid, arguing that failing to meet an artist's preferred methods or subjective expectations was not a breach, that many of the alleged violations concerned the conduct of a third party it could not force to apologize or reach agreements, that demanding legal action against third parties without clear grounds was not appropriate under the purpose of an exclusive contract, and that it had properly handled key contract matters such as scheduling, compensation and settlement. ADOR said it regretted not meeting the members in person during the two weeks after the letter and hoped for dialogue.

editor_note: Source fnnews (2024-11-29). The 'third party' in ADOR's reply is understood in coverage to mean former CEO Min Hee-jin (an inference, kept out of reader text). The statement builds on the previous day's press-conference position that ADOR and HYBE breached first and no penalty is owed. / 2026-10-24 nightly: Financial News (2024-11-29 11:26 KST) confirms the members' position that the contract had ended and no injunction was needed, and ADOR's same-day email reply (contract still valid, third-party issues, regret at no in-person meeting, hope for dialogue).

title.ja: ADOR、専属契約有効確認の訴えをソウル中央地裁に提起
title.en: ADOR files suit at Seoul Central District Court to confirm contract validity

summary.ja: ADORがメンバー5人を相手に、専属契約が有効であることの確認を求める訴えを起こした。
summary.en: ADOR sued the five members seeking confirmation that their exclusive contracts remain valid.

editor_note: Filed 12-03 per Khan ('지난 3일 ... 제기했다고 전날(5일) 밝혔다'); English Wikipedia gives 12-05 (the announcement date). Dated by filing. / Removed source mention from reader text: Sports Kyunghyang. / 2026-10-24 nightly: ADOR's statement, quoted in full by Sports Kyunghyang (2024-12-05 13:51), says '당사는 지난 12월 3일 ... 전속계약이 유효하게 존속한다는 점을 ... 소를 제기' — filing date 12-03 and announcement 12-05 confirmed from ADOR's own wording.

detail.ja: ADORがメンバー5人を相手取り、専属契約が有効に存続することの確認を求める訴えをソウル中央地裁に起こし、12月5日に公表した。紛争を法的判断で解決することは望んでいなかったが、専属契約が一方の主張だけで軽々しく解除されるものではないことを示すためのやむを得ない措置だとし、アイドルグループには長期的な投資が必要で、専属契約が守られなければその投資は保護されないと述べた。NewJeansと共に歩む立場は変わらず、訴訟とは別に率直な対話で誤解を解きたいとした。メンバー側は11月28日の会見で自ら法的措置は取らないとしていたため、解除を主張する側が仮処分を申請する通常の形とは逆に、ADORが先に提訴する形となった。
detail.en: ADOR filed a suit at the Seoul Central District Court against the five members seeking confirmation that their exclusive contracts remain valid, announcing it on December 5. ADOR said it had not wanted the dispute settled by legal judgment but considered the step unavoidable to show that an exclusive contract cannot be terminated lightly on one side's claim alone, and argued that idol groups require long-term investment that would go unprotected if contracts were not honored. It said its wish to continue with NewJeans was unchanged and that it hoped for honest dialogue apart from the litigation to clear up misunderstandings. Because the members had said at their November 28 press conference that they would not take legal action themselves, ADOR filed first, reversing the usual pattern in which the party seeking termination applies for an injunction.

detail.en: On January 13 ADOR announced that the previous week it had applied to the Seoul Central District Court for an injunction against the five members to preserve its status as their agency and bar advertising and similar contracts. It said the aim was to have its status as the members' management company under the exclusive contracts recognized until the first-instance ruling in the contract-validity suit it filed on December 3, 2024, and to prevent the members from signing advertising contracts or doing advertising work on their own without its approval or consent. ADOR argued that continued market confusion from the members' independent moves would inevitably damage the brand value of NewJeans, its only artist, and that even if the contracts were upheld years later, the harm might be irreversible. It also conveyed industry concern that a precedent of declaring termination unilaterally and working independently without legal process would erode investment in the industry.

detail.en: The Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 50 (presiding judge Kim Sang-hoon) heard ADOR's injunction application to preserve its agency status and bar advertising contracts, with all five members attending although they were not required to. The members' side argued that the heart of the case was that ADOR and HYBE had discriminated against and excluded them and sought to replace them with another group, so termination was justified. detail.ja: ソウル中央地裁民事合議50部（キム・サンフン首席部長判事）は、ADORが申請した企画会社地位保全・広告契約締結等禁止の仮処分を全部認め、本案の1審判決まで、メンバーはADORの事前の承認・同意なしに自ら、またはADOR以外の第三者を通じて芸能活動をしてはならないとした。ADORは1月の申請後、作詞・作曲・歌唱などの音楽活動を含む芸能活動全般へと禁止の範囲を広げていた。裁判所は、信頼関係が壊れれば専属契約を解除できるが、終了を主張する側が維持の困難を疎明する必要があるとし、ミン・ヒジン前代表の解任だけでは制作が停滞したとは言えず、ADORに事業を遂行する計画や能力がないとも断定しがたいと判断した。メンバー側は2月6日にNJZの商標を出願し、3月23日のComplexCon香港で新曲を披露する予定だった。
detail.en: The Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 50 (presiding judge Kim Sang-hoon) granted in full ADOR's injunction to preserve its status as the members' agency and bar advertising and similar contracts, ordering that until the first-instance judgment in the main suit the members may not engage in entertainment activities on their own or through third parties without ADOR's prior approval or consent. After filing in January, ADOR had widened the application to all entertainment work, including writing lyrics, composing and singing. The court held that an artist may terminate an exclusive contract when trust breaks down, but the party claiming termination must show the relationship has become too difficult to maintain; it found that former CEO Min Hee-jin's dismissal alone did not show production had stalled and that it was hard to conclude ADOR lacked plans or ability to run the group's business. The members had filed a trademark application for NJZ on February 6 and planned to present a new song at ComplexCon Hong Kong on March 23.

detail.ja: ソウル中央地裁民事合議50部（キム・サンフン首席部長判事）は、メンバー5人が3月21日の仮処分決定に対して申し立てた異議を棄却し、独自活動を禁じる原決定を認可した。提出資料ではADORの契約違反や契約を終わらせるほどの信頼関係の破綻が十分に疎明されたとは言い難いとし、ミン・ヒジン前代表の解任はADORの経営判断でメンバーのプロデュース業務に直接関係せず、契約がミン前代表のプロデュースを前提としていた証拠もないとした。広告制作会社トルゴレユグェダン（Dolphiners Films）との紛争も本件の当事者でない者同士の争いで、それだけでADORが重要な義務に違反したとは言えないと判断した。メンバー側の代理人（法務法人セジョン）は同日、ソウル高裁に即時抗告した。
detail.en: The Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 50 (presiding judge Kim Sang-hoon) dismissed the five members' objection to the March 21 injunction and affirmed the original decision barring independent activities. The court found that the materials submitted did not sufficiently show a breach by ADOR or a breakdown of trust severe enough to end the contract, that the dismissal of former CEO Min Hee-jin was an ADOR management decision not directly tied to producing work for the members, and that there was no evidence the contract was premised on her producing. It also held that a dispute involving the ad production company Dolphiners Films (Dolgorae Yugoedan), a non-party, did not by itself show ADOR had breached a material obligation. The members' counsel, the law firm Sejong (Shin & Kim), filed an immediate appeal with the Seoul High Court the same day.

A Seoul High Court decision; changed njz -> newjeans.

detail.ja: ソウル高裁民事25-2部（ファン・ビョンハ、チョン・ジョングァン、イ・ギュニョン部長判事）は、メンバー5人が仮処分の認可決定に対して申し立てた即時抗告を棄却し、独自活動を禁じる仮処分を維持した。メンバーが契約を離れて独自に活動すれば、ADORは過去の投資を回収する機会を失う一方でメンバーが将来の収益をすべて得ることになり不合理だとし、ミン・ヒジン前代表の役割は契約に定められておらず、その解任はHYBEとミン前代表の経営権をめぐる紛争から生じたもので、それ自体が契約の基礎となる信頼を壊すものではないと判断した。ADORがメンバーへの信頼を保っている以上、解除の要件となる信頼関係の破綻は認められず、本案の結論が出るまで仮処分が必要だとした。
detail.en: The Seoul High Court's Civil Division 25-2 (judges Hwang Byung-ha, Jung Jong-kwan and Lee Kyun-yong) dismissed the five members' immediate appeal against the affirmation of the injunction, upholding the ban on independent activities. It reasoned that if the members left the contract and worked independently, ADOR would lose the chance to recoup its past investment while the members would effectively keep all future earnings, which it called unreasonable; that Min Hee-jin's role was not written into the contract and her removal as CEO arose from a management-control dispute between HYBE and Min, which did not by itself break the trust underlying the contract; and that because ADOR still maintained its trust in the members, the breakdown required for termination was not established, so the injunction was needed until the main suit was decided.

credits.court: Seoul High Court, Civil Division 25-2 (presiding judge Hwang Byung-ha)

title.ja: 再抗告なし、独自活動禁止の仮処分が確定
title.en: No further appeal: injunction barring independent activities becomes final

Until the main suit is decided, the members therefore may not engage in entertainment activities on their own or through third parties without ADOR's prior approval or consent, covering songwriting, performing, broadcast appearances, advertising negotiations and commercial activities. The appeals court had also rejected the argument that Min Hee-jin must serve as ADOR's CEO or lead NewJeans' production.

title.ja: 本案訴訟の第1回調停期日、合意に至らず

summary.ja: 専属契約有効確認訴訟の第1回調停にミンジとダニエルが出席したが、合意には至らなかった。
summary.en: Minji and Danielle attended the first mediation session in the contract-validity suit, which ended without agreement.

detail.ja: ソウル中央地裁民事合議41部（チョン・フェイル部長判事）で、ADORがメンバー5人を相手に起こした専属契約有効確認訴訟の調停が14時から15時21分まで非公開で行われた。前回の弁論で裁判長がメンバーの出席を求めたことを受け、ミンジとダニエルが出席した。合意には至らず、第2回調停は9月11日、不成立なら10月30日に判決を言い渡す予定とされた。4月の第1回弁論では、ADORが解除事由はなく契約第15条1項の14日間の是正期間も与えられなかったと主張し、メンバー側はミン・ヒジン前代表への報復的措置で信頼関係が壊れ、紛争後6〜7か月間ADORから連絡も是正措置もなかったと主張していた。
detail.en: The Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 41 (presiding judge Jung Hoe-il) held a closed mediation session from 2:00 to 3:21 pm in ADOR's contract-validity suit against the five members; Minji and Danielle attended after the judge had asked at the previous hearing for the members to appear. The session ended without agreement, a second session was set for September 11, and the court said it would deliver judgment on October 30 if mediation failed. At the first hearing in April, ADOR had argued there were no grounds for termination and that the 14-day cure period under Article 15(1) of the contract had not been given, while the members argued that ADOR's retaliatory actions against former CEO Min Hee-jin had broken trust and that ADOR had made no contact or corrective steps for six to seven months after the dispute began.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 41 (presiding judge Jung Hoe-il)

detail.ja: ソウル中央地裁民事合議41部（チョン・フェイル部長判事）は、ADORがメンバー5人を相手に起こした専属契約有効確認訴訟で原告ADOR勝訴の判決を言い渡し、専属契約はなお有効だと認めた。ADORが企画会社としての義務に違反したとは認められないとし、ミン・ヒジン前代表の解任が契約違反にあたるという主張と、信頼関係の破綻を理由とする解除の主張をいずれも退け、「信頼関係破綻の外観を作って専属契約から逃れようとする試みは許されるべきでない」と述べた。ADORは判決に感謝し、企画会社としての役割を省みるとともに、正規アルバムの発売など活動の準備を終えて待っているとして、アーティストとともにファンのもとへ戻ると表明した。メンバー5人は控訴の意向を示した。
detail.en: The Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 41 (presiding judge Jung Hoe-il) ruled for the plaintiff ADOR in its contract-validity suit against the five members, holding that the exclusive contracts remain valid. The court found that ADOR had not breached its obligations as the management company, rejected both the argument that former CEO Min Hee-jin's dismissal breached the contract and the claim of termination for breakdown of trust, and said that attempts to escape an exclusive contract by manufacturing the appearance of broken trust should not be permitted. ADOR thanked the court, said it would reflect on its role as a management company, said it had completed preparations for activities including a full-length album and was waiting, and pledged to bring the artists back to fans. The five members indicated they would appeal.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 41 (presiding judge Jung Hoe-il)

detail.ja: 4月中旬にヘリン、ヘイン、ハニがコペンハーゲンで目撃され、ADOR名義で13日から16日まで予約された現地レコーディングスタジオのスケジュール表がオンラインコミュニティで出回ったことを受け、ADORが立場を出した。ADORは「NewJeansのメンバーは現在、メンバーごとのコンディションと各自に最適化されたスケジュールに従って活動を準備している」とし、コペンハーゲン訪問は「NewJeansの新しい音楽的叙事を盛り込むための事前プロダクション過程の一環だった」と説明して、今後の歩みは最も良い時期に公式に伝えるとした。当時ヘリン、ヘイン、ハニはADORに復帰済みで、ダニエルは契約解除後に係争中、ミンジは去就未定だった。
detail.en: ADOR issued a statement after Haerin, Hyein and Hanni were sighted in Copenhagen in mid-April and a local recording studio's schedule sheet showing bookings under ADOR's name from the 13th to the 16th circulated on an online community. ADOR said the NewJeans members were preparing activities according to each member's condition and a schedule optimized for her, described the Copenhagen visit as part of the pre-production process for a new musical narrative for NewJeans, and said it would officially announce their next steps at the best time. At the time Haerin, Hyein and Hanni had returned to ADOR, Danielle was in dispute after her contract was terminated, and Minji's status was undecided.

title.ja: ADOR、『How Sweet』盗作訴訟に「盗作ではない」と反論
title.en: ADOR denies plagiarism after 'How Sweet' copyright suit

summary.ja: 米国で「How Sweet」の盗作を主張する訴訟が起こされ、ADORは制作陣BANAの確認をもとに盗作ではないと反論した。
summary.en: After a US suit claimed 'How Sweet' was plagiarized, ADOR denied it, citing confirmation from production team BANA.

detail.ja: Audrey Amacostら作曲家4人が5月8日（米国時間）、「How Sweet」は自分たちのデモ「One of a Kind」を盗用したとして、NewJeans、ADOR、HYBEとメンバー5人を相手に米国でロイヤルティを求める訴訟を起こした。原告側は、両曲は調と拍子が同じで第1バースのメロディーと構成が似ており、31音のメロディー列がほぼ同一だと主張し、NewJeansにトップラインを提供したが使われなかったとした。ADORは5月9日、同曲の作曲とプロデュースを担当した外部制作チームBANAに確認した結果、盗作の事実はないとの立場を受け取ったとして、ADORとメンバーもBANAの立場に沿って訴訟に積極的に対応すると明らかにした。「How Sweet」は2024年5月のダブルシングルのタイトル曲で、ミン・ヒジン前代表が総括プロデュースを務めていた時期にBANAと制作された。
detail.en: On May 8 (US time), four songwriters led by Audrey Amacost sued NewJeans, ADOR, HYBE and the five members in the United States, claiming 'How Sweet' copied their demo 'One of a Kind' and seeking royalties. The plaintiffs alleged that both songs share the same key and meter, that the first-verse melody and structure are similar, that a 31-note melodic sequence is nearly identical, and that they had offered NewJeans a topline that was not used. On May 9 ADOR said it had checked with the external production team BANA, which composed and produced the song, and had been told there was no plagiarism, and that ADOR and the members would respond actively to the suit in line with BANA's position. 'How Sweet' was the title track of the May 2024 double single, made with BANA while then-CEO Min Hee-jin was overall producer.

title.ja: デビュー4周年「2026 Summer of NewJeans」公開、ADOR「活動計画は協議終了後に発表」

Special films under each member's name were also posted on YouTube, with group and individual photos on the official social accounts. Danielle was not included. It was the first group content in about a year and four months, since ComplexCon Hong Kong in March 2025. ADOR said the video was commemorative content made to enjoy with fans and that specific activity plans and formats would be announced once discussions were fully concluded. At the time Haerin, Hyein and Hanni had returned, and ADOR had said talks with Minji were progressing positively.

Cut for length: the hearing dealt mainly with procedural questions such as how appraisal materials should be reviewed; ADOR opposed handing over original appraisal materials because the defendants work in the same industry and the court proposed a review with an accountant present; the court also asked both sides whether continuing scheduled activities after the termination declaration counted as refusal of performance, and whether alleged plagiarism by another HYBE group and a label employee's alleged refusal to greet a member should be treated as separate issues. / 2026-10-24 nightly: Fetched MTN (10 Sep 2026 18:04, '[MTN 현장+]', reporter in court): Seoul Central District Court Civil Division 31 (presiding judge Nam In-su) held the 5th hearing on the 10th in ADOR's ~33.1 billion won damages suit against Danielle, her mother and Min Hee-jin; appraisal of one year of lost profit from 29 Nov 2024; Danielle's counsel demanded a normalisation plan citing good faith; ADOR's counsel replied as quoted; next hearing 22 Oct. All points in the record match. No court page available; confirmed via in-court press report.

detail.ja: ADORがダニエルとその母親、ミン・ヒジン前代表を相手に約331億ウォンの損害賠償を求める訴訟の第5回弁論が、ソウル中央地裁民事合議31部（ナム・インス部長判事）で開かれた。損害は2024年11月29日の解除通告を起点とする1年間の逸失利益として算定され、鑑定が進んでいた。ダニエル側は、メンバーの復帰表明から1年近く具体的な活動がないのは信義則違反になり得るとして、活動正常化の計画の提出をADORに求めた。ADOR側は、活動計画はプロモーションを経て発表するもので先に求めるのは筋が通らないとし、ダニエルの不在で活動が遅れた可能性は認めつつ「復帰プランなしに戻ってきているはずがない」と述べた。次回は10月22日。
detail.en: The Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 31 (presiding judge Nam In-su) held the fifth hearing in ADOR's damages suit of about 33.1 billion won against Danielle, her mother and former CEO Min Hee-jin. Damages were being calculated as one year of lost profit from the November 29, 2024 termination notice, with an appraisal under way. Danielle's side asked ADOR to submit a plan for normalizing NewJeans' activities, arguing that the absence of concrete activity nearly a year after the members declared their return could breach the principle of good faith. ADOR's side said activity plans are announced through a promotion process, so demanding them first was illogical, and while acknowledging Danielle's absence may have delayed activities, said it was implausible that the group had returned without a plan. The next hearing was set for October 22.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 31 (presiding judge Nam In-su)

title.ja: ADORの対ダニエル損害賠償訴訟で第6回弁論、損害算定の資料と「ミン・ヒジン効果」で応酬
title.en: Sixth hearing in ADOR's damages suit against Danielle: clash over appraisal materials and the 'Min Hee-jin effect'

summary.ja: 約331億ウォンの損害賠償訴訟の第6回弁論で、ダニエル側はADORが鑑定資料の提出を遅らせていると主張し、ADORは否定した。
summary.en: At the sixth hearing of the roughly 33.1 billion won damages suit, Danielle's side accused ADOR of delaying appraisal materials, which ADOR denied.

detail.ja: ソウル中央地裁民事合議31部（ナム・インス部長判事）で、ADORがダニエルとその母親、ミン・ヒジン前代表に約331億ウォンの違約罰・損害賠償を求める訴訟の第6回弁論が開かれた。ダニエル側は、鑑定人が8月4日に求めた18項目のうち5項目が未提出で、前日夜に一部が出されたにすぎないとして、ADORが意図的に訴訟を遅らせていると主張した。ADOR側は、提出可能な資料の大半は9月に出しており、営業秘密に関わる資料や複数レーベルからの取りまとめに時間がかかっただけで、遅らせる意図はないと反論した。裁判長は、鑑定ではミン前代表の寄与（「ミン・ヒジン効果」）をどう反映するかが最も重要だとし、ほかのグループの実績を比較に使うことの妥当性や、維持された広告契約と中断した契約の区別についても検討を求めた。次回は11月12日、その次は12月3日に指定された。
detail.en: The Seoul Central District Court's Civil Division 31 (presiding judge Nam In-su) held the sixth hearing in ADOR's suit seeking about 33.1 billion won in penalties and damages from Danielle, her mother and former CEO Min Hee-jin. Danielle's side said five of the 18 items the court-appointed appraiser had requested on August 4 were still missing, with only some submitted the previous evening, and accused ADOR of deliberately delaying the case. ADOR's side replied that it had submitted most available materials in September, that items involving trade secrets and collecting data from several labels had taken time, and that it had no intention of delaying. The presiding judge said the most important question for the appraisal was how to reflect Min's contribution (the 'Min Hee-jin effect'), and asked the parties to consider whether another group's results could serve as a comparison and how to separate advertising contracts that continued from those that were halted. The next hearings were set for November 12 and December 3.

credits.court: Seoul Central District Court, Civil Division 31 (presiding judge Nam In-su)
